data.title: Vivy · 休演日的调音练习
data.description: 休演日的小排练室，Vivy 穿淡蓝衬衫和白长裤坐在电子琴旁，按下一个琴键后侧耳听余音。她把便签移到谱架边，再调整呼吸准备唱出同一音高，蓝眼里的认真比舞台灯光更清楚。
data.action: 按下一个琴键听余音，调整坐姿准备跟唱。
data.promptProse: Vivy sits beside the electronic piano on a performance-free day, pressing one key and listening closely to its fading tone. She moves a sticky note beside the music stand and steadies her breath to sing the same pitch. Her pale-blue collared shirt and white wide-leg trousers remain practical. Soft frontal window light reveals her focused blue eyes and keyboard in the medium view, with subdued key and sheet shadows below.
